Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to identify the director of "Sweepings" accurately during its initial search. While it eventually retrieved the correct director (John Cromwell) and his death date (September 26, 1979), the process was delayed due to inefficient search queries and a lack of systematic verification of the edition of the film "Sweepings" being considered. This inefficiency led to ambiguity in the analysis and consumed unnecessary time, even though the correct answer was ultimately derived.
